entities.summary: Kai August Forbath is an American former professional football player who was a placekicker in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the UCLA Bruins, earning consensus All-American honors and winning the Lou Groza Award in 2009. Forbath signed with the Dallas Cowboys as an undrafted free agent in 2011. He was also a member of the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, Washington Redskins, New Orleans Saints, Minnesota Vikings, Jacksonville Jaguars, New England Patriots, Carolina Panthers, and Los Angeles Rams.
